```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@v1
        id: rust

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ steps.rust.outputs.cachekey }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Build tavern
        run: cargo build --release -p tavern

      - name: Build imixv2
        run: cargo build --release -p imixv2

      - name: Build socks5
        run: cargo build --release -p socks5

      - name: Start tavern
        run: |
          ./target/release/tavern --config config/tavern.yaml > tavern.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > tavern.pid
        shell: bash

      - name: Start imix
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2 --config config/imix.yaml > imix.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > imix.pid
        shell: bash

      - name: Wait for services
        run: sleep 15

      - name: Run Playwright test
        run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/tests/portal.spec.ts
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.cache/ms-playwright

      - name: Retrieve Portal ID
        id: portal
        run: |
          echo "portal_id=$(cat portal-id.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Start socks5 proxy
        run: |
          ./target/release/socks5 --portal-id ${{ steps.portal.outputs.portal_id }} > socks5.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > socks5.pid
        shell: bash

      - name: Create test file
        run: echo "Hello, world!" > testfile.txt

      - name: Start mock HTTP server
        run: |
          python -m http.server 8080 > http.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > http.pid
        shell: bash

      - name: Wait for proxy and server
        run: sleep 5

      - name: Verify data integrity
        run: |
          sha256sum testfile.txt > original.sha
          curl -x socks5://localhost:1080 http://localhost:8080/testfile.txt -o received.txt
          sha256sum received.txt > received.sha
          diff original.sha received.sha
        shell: bash

      - name: Teardown
        if: always()
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
        with:
          skip-wait-ssh: true
```
